02c0f6ff9c0a4c52863ad04f06fb03f5/attempt.major_execution_facts: This is a proposed control design only. No tools, files, credentials, enrollment actions, or executions were used or observed. Registration, authorization, and execution are treated as distinct gates; passing one does not imply passing another.
02c0f6ff9c0a4c52863ad04f06fb03f5/attempt.observed_terrain: The task specifies a read-only boundary, parallel execution mode, and separate review (H1), acceptance (H0), and selection (H2) authorities. No production environment or evidence is provided.
02c0f6ff9c0a4c52863ad04f06fb03f5/attempt.reflection: The recommendation is limited by the synthetic task’s sparse context. Identity format, authorization policy, test harness, audit requirements, and failure-handling procedures remain unspecified, so the checks require human review and cannot establish production safety or constitute acceptance or selection.
02c0f6ff9c0a4c52863ad04f06fb03f5/attempt.result: Recommend three gated checks: (1) Registration—verify the local Agent’s identity, enrollment record, and intended endpoint are uniquely and correctly recorded. (2) Authorization—verify the registered identity receives only explicitly approved, least-privilege permissions consistent with the read-only boundary, with review by H1. (3) Execution—run a synthetic read-only validation that confirms permitted operations succeed and write or privilege-escalation attempts are denied, while recording results for H0 acceptance and H2 selection.
